title: SCP-4910, The Grinner
description: A predator with a lot of teeth that drives its victims insane by growing more teeth in pain...
body:
The Grinner adds a new monster. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-4910, also known as the Grinner.


This terrifying entity has the ability to leap onto its targets and giving nearby players the new Dentophonia effect. At higher stages, Dentophobia causes weakness, nausea, and eventually severe damage. If a player dies while at Stage 3, another SCP-4910 will spawn. This effect can be removed with the Molar Serum, a craftable cure that stops the grow of teeth. When weakened, it may attempt to flee or enter a dangerous rage. The Grinner may not be strong, but if itself doesn't kill you, it's effect will.

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-4910 spawn?

SCP-4910 can spawn anywhere on the overworld surface like a normal monster. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-4910.

► How can I craft a Moral Serum?

A Moral Serum can be crafted by using 1 bone meal, 1 sweet berries, 1 glass bottle and two sugar. I recommend to use Just Enough Items to see the crafting recipies.

</details>



![SCP-4910](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b21fb14cea0b21509bcac9954ab6f48f3c61215a.png)

SCP-4910 is a monster that spawns on the surface at night. It is agile, able to leap toward players and overwhelm them in close combat. When its health drops below 30, SCP-4910 may flee or enter a rage mode, becoming even more aggressive. The entity is capable of breaking glass blocks, making it harder to contain. Being close up to 8 blocks to an Aggressive SCP-4910 will give players the Dentophobia effect, which builds up even faster when players are close to an aggressive SCP-4910. At first this effect seems harmless, but after time, the screen will be filled with more teeth, sometimes the player even takes damage or gets nauseas. If a victim dies with stage 3 of Dentophobia, a new Instance of SCP-4910 will spawn.
